items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: In fact, I never heard soloing on drums, outside of Baby Dodds, doing the things he did.

ctx.x: In fact, I never heard soloing on drums, outside of Baby Dodds, doing the things he did. I never heard soloing in those days. The drummer played drums for the band. You didn't take no breaks. And here is Augie, just laying down that beat, and -- let's get it going, maybe it'll take us two hours, to hit that beautiful groove where the world could come to an end and it doesn't matter.
